reasoning_summary: The option states insert-or-read but does not fully specify visibility behavior when the conflicting transaction is still in progress.
supporting_findings: The durable uniqueness boundary serializes writes but does not itself define follower read timing.
alternative_interpretations: Database isolation may block the conflicting insert until the winner commits, depending on the actual database path.
falsification_conditions: A reproducible database test proves the existing conflict path always observes the committed winner without additional behavior.
impact_if_wrong: Equivalent callers can receive a transient not-found or incorrect failure.
